sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Diamond Petal Fringe Gold Stainless Steel Hoop Earrings
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Bold, structured, and strikingly unique — our Diamond Petal Fringe Hoop Earrings feature a cascading row of raised oval petals along the hoop with a standout diamond-shaped centrepiece at the base. A modern architectural design that brings serious style to any outfit.
- 316L Stainless Steel — rust-proof, tarnish-proof & skin-safe
- Gold-plated finish — rich, long-lasting shine
- Waterproof & sweat-resistant — built for everyday wear
- Diamond shape centrepiece + layered petal detail
- Statement hoop — lightweight despite bold appearance
Pairs with: Solid colour ethnic wear, blazers, off-shoulder tops, and sarees.
Stainless steel is highly durable and water-resistant. Avoid prolonged exposure to harsh chemicals and perfumes.
